assembly_notes: Root is `chassis` (the hidden steel underframe). `cargo_shell` is its FIXED child through `body_mount`, welded at the deck datum where the deck crossmember top face meets the moulded floor underside; the shell link is authored in that datum frame so the weld origin sits on real hardware on both sides. There is NO hopper tilt/dump joint anywhere - a tipping body is the sibling subcategory Tilt Truck2 and stays excluded. Every reachable configuration therefore carries at least three movable joints from the rolling gear alone: two CONTINUOUS rear road wheel rolls on one lateral axle line plus one CONTINUOUS front wheel roll; the swivel caster adds a CONTINUOUS vertical swivel, the brake candidate a bounded REVOLUTE step pedal, the folding handle a bounded REVOLUTE fold and the hinged lid a bounded REVOLUTE rim hinge. There are no compatibility gates: `shell_form` publishes one plan descriptor (station outline at any height) that the deck seat, wheel track, rib footprints, perimeter bumper ring, rear flange handle datum and lid outline all resolve against, so a V-nose or stadium hopper on any underframe builds a matching bumper ring, rib seat and lid rather than being excluded. The lid hinge sits forward of the handle datum on the same rear flange and opens up-and-back, so the folding handle (which folds rearward) and the lid never share swept space.
